summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing share buy-back program announced 5 August 2026, purchasing 10,000 shares on UK venues and 340,000 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 28 August 2026 for cancellation. Prices ranged from £15.1540 to £15.2860 per share on UK venues and HK$160.20 to HK$162.00 in Hong Kong. Since inception, HSBC repurchased 23,559,014 shares for approximately US$485.3 million. BNP Paribas executed trades. Shares repurchased are cancelled, reducing issued capital. Watch for continued buy-back progress and potential impact on EPS and share price.
